kjv: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
note: TR's 18:11 ("elthen gar ho huios tou anthropou sosai to apololos") is imported from Luke 19:10; absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, Theta and early versions.
hebdomekontakis hepta echoes LXX Gen 4:24 (Lamech's "seventy-seven-fold"), so 77 is the likely meaning; 490 is a possible reading of the Greek.

kjv: forgive not every one his brother their trespasses
mine: if you do not forgive your brother from your heart
note: TR adds "ta paraptomata auton" ("their trespasses") at the end; absent from the earliest manuscripts.
